message: The other night, I experienced a blackout that lasted way longer than I expected. As I fumbled around for my flashlight, I realized I had stashed away a small army of power banks and lanterns—because why not? 😂 While my neighbors were scrambling for candles, I was cozy under my blankets with a fully charged phone and a glow from my trusty lantern. It reminded me that being a little over-prepared can turn a potential hassle into a cozy night in. What’s your favorite tip for staying comfy during a power outage?
